title: Alternating expansion of product kernels
statement: Let $I$ be a finite set, $S\subseteq I$, and let $a,b:I\to\mathbb R$. Then $\sum_{T\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|T|}\prod_{i\in I}\bigl(a_i\text{ if }i\in T,\ b_i\text{ otherwise}\bigr)=\prod_{i\in I}\bigl(a_i-b_i\text{ if }i\in S,\ b_i\text{ otherwise}\bigr)$.
hypotheses_covered: I is a finite index set
S is a subset of I
a and b are real-valued functions on I
replaced: For a finite set $I$, $S\subseteq I$, and real functions $a,b$ on $I$, $\sum_{T\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|T|}\prod_{i\in T}a_i\prod_{i\notin T}b_i=\prod_{i\in S}(a_i-b_i)\prod_{i\notin S}b_i$.
